page.overview:
What is Majiatsuka Kingdom?

The Majiatsuka Kingdom is a southern country in the New World that Rolling Logan comes from.

Nothing is known about the country's geography, but it is described as a "tropical country".

Rolling Logan is the only citizen to be shown so far.

Nothing is known about the kingdom's history because it has yet to make an appearance.
